title: automation: the region refusal leaves its child run uncancelled with only a warn when the suspension chain cannot be read, and a region call reached through a child's top-level call still arms
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

Filing gate: ① two should-fix items of the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review PASS on PR #29096 (comment 6572481670, head `65a94546`), carried so #28897 can close over its landed scope. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 · both are edges of a narrowing that already fails loudly at run time; nothing is granted or disclosed.

Reach: a record-triggered flow whose `loop` / `parallel` / `try_catch` region calls a child that can suspend (item 1), or whose top-level `subflow` calls a child that itself makes such a region call (item 2).
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (`packages/services/service-automation`).

## What happens (read at PR #29096's head, not measured on this card)

1. **Empty cancel chain.** `runRegion` (`dag-traversal.ts`) cancels the child run the region refusal leaves behind by walking `resolveSuspensionChain(childRunId)`. That walk reads through the degrading `loadSuspendedRun` (`run-resume.ts`), so a store it cannot read yields an empty chain: zero `cancelRun` calls and only a `warn`. The PR body's claim that a failed cancellation is logged at `error` does not hold on that path, and the child run can stay parked.
2. **Transitive shape.** The arming decline (`declineOntoRegionSuspendingCall`, `engine.ts`) judges region-nested calls in the caller itself. A caller whose top-level `subflow` reaches a child whose own region call reaches a suspending grandchild still arms; at run time the child fails at its own region and the caller fails loudly (no orphan after item 1's cancel).

## Wanted

- (1) When the chain is empty, call `cancelRun(childRunId, reason)` once so its strict loader owns the `error` record; a test with an unreadable store, red first.
- (2) Measure first whether the transitive shape should decline at arming (one more walk over `suspendingNode`'s `through` chain) or whether the loud run-time failure is the intended answer; build the decline only if the reading is unambiguous, otherwise report the fork.

Dedupe: searched `resolveSuspensionChain empty cancel`, `region suspending grandchild arm`; none. **New.**

Links back: #28897, PR #29096, #28846, PR #28959.
